definitions.gloss: spine, back, line of the back
definitions.explanation: The line running down the center of the back, or the back as it relates to posture. Often used when talking about straightening or correcting one's posture.

examples.japanese: {背筋|せすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばして→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{背筋|せすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}った→凍る：02100_kooru⟧。
examples.english: That scary story sent chills down my spine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{背筋|せすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧にして、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In job interviews, it's important to sit up straight and speak while looking the other person in the eye.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
When referring to posture and the line of the back, the reading is せすじ. When referring specifically to the back muscles (as in exercise/anatomy), it is read as はいきん. The two readings represent different meanings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背筋|せすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧ (straighten one's back, sit/stand up straight)
- {背筋|せすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧ (a chill runs down one's spine)
- {背筋|せすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぞっと→ぞっと：05272_zotto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (feel a shiver down one's spine)
- {背筋|せすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (have good posture)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: posture (more general, can be abstract — attitude/stance)
- ⟦{背骨|せぼね}→背骨：17397_sebone⟧: spine, backbone (the actual bones of the spinal column)
